"Take Me Home" is a song written and performed by the English drummer, singer and songwriter Phil Collins.
It is the tenth and final track on Collins' third solo studio album, No Jacket Required.
Collins co-produced the song with Hugh Padgham and released it as a single in the UK in July 1985 and the US in March 1986.
No Jacket Required is the third solo album by the English drummer and singer-songwriter Phil Collins.
It was released on 18 February 1985 by Virgin Records in the UK and by Atlantic and WEA internationally.
After finishing touring commitments with Genesis and working with Eric Clapton in 1984, Collins resumed his solo career and started work on a new album.
Philip David Charles Collins (born 30 January 1951) is an English singer, drummer, songwriter, record producer, and actor.
